concept_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one production concept image for an image-to-3D game asset generator: the vehicle "扫荡者" (Sweeper), with NO written text.
Input image 1 is only the chassis/proportion reference: a compact Wheeled Bug with exactly four chunky wheels, front and rear wheels in matched left-right pairs, side armor, a raised rear armored deck. Input image 2 (the spaceship) is ONLY the visual-language reference: clean hard-surface panel shapes, restrained crisp ink lines, flat matte color blocks, gentle 3-tone cel shading. Do NOT borrow the spaceship's blue-and-white palette or its spaceship shape.
Replace the empty cockpit of the wheeled vehicle with ONE centered, forward-facing machine gun on a visible horizontal pitch trunnion. A compact boxy receiver, single straight barrel, readable muzzle. Gun can pitch but is centered on the longitudinal axis. No human cockpit/windows. Preserve recognizable bug chassis and low wide stance. Make the armor more intentional and planar, small consistent chamfers; no faceted triangle confetti, no dented melted surfaces. EXACT bilateral geometry and color symmetry, centered short antenna, all axles straight/coaxial.
Palette is vivid burnt-orange / orange-red main armor (roughly 55%), warm ivory white panels (25%), readable mid-value desaturated blue-gray mechanism and tires (20%). Small warm yellow lamps. No dominant cyan or blue armor. Bright readable midtones like the spaceship, very limited near-black recesses.
Render as polished anime low-poly hard-surface game concept art, clean big planes, sparse purposeful dark navy panel seams, subtle 3-tone light and shadow, no weathering, no realistic texture noise or gloss. Not pencil doodle. Isolated SINGLE complete vehicle against plain off-white background, 3/4 front perspective, at slightly elevated angle so four-wheel layout and top machine gun can be understood. Entire silhouette including every wheel and gun within frame, generous 10% margins. No pedestal, no floor plane, no cast shadow, no smoke, no firing effect, no text/labels/logo, no UI, no multi-view collage. Design ready to be reconstructed as a symmetric mechanical mesh.

views.front:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production orthographic turnaround view for Tripo multi-view reconstruction. The attached image is the APPROVED vehicle design. Keep EXACT identity, shape, dimensions, orange-red and ivory panel layout, blue-gray four wheels, wheel hub style, single centered machine gun with box receiver and pitch trunnions, raised rear armor with centered aerial, two forward headlamps, sparse navy panel lines. Do not redesign it, do not add guns/pods/windows, do not borrow a blue armor palette. The vehicle is perfectly bilaterally symmetric with two matched wheels per axle, four wheels total. Clean bright flat matte anime hard-surface cel shading matching the reference, with only 2-3 tones; no weathering/noise or dramatic shadows. SINGLE vehicle, pure white background, no cast shadows, no text/labels/borders/arrows, no perspective, entire silhouette visible with 10% margin, no multi-view collage.
STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC FRONT ELEVATION. Camera horizontally straight into the gun muzzle and vehicle nose, no downward tilt, absolutely no yaw. The gun bore points directly at the viewer, centered. Front pair of wheels beside the nose; larger rear wheel pair can peek symmetrically outside them behind. Front armor and headlights are mirror symmetric. The centered aerial rises behind the raised rear body. Ground line horizontal. The weapon barrel is foreshortened to its muzzle shape, NOT visible sideways.
